svg.title: Component · Output actions · video · no-edits · narrow
svg.desc: Mirrors GalleryPreviewPanel.outputSection's button row for a VIDEO project (App/GalleryPreviewPanel.swift, both dresses since 2026-11-05 — the pane beside the grid and the item view's inspector; docs/approved-assets.md): New clip (the blend flow) · Render Edits (RenderEditsButton — wand.and.stars: the clip at 1× with the editor's edits baked in and its sound kept, stored as an edited clip) · Share project (the .lapse archive). The same actionButton as the other states: 57 pt tall, radius 9, primary at 7 %, a 16 pt medium glyph over an 11 pt medium label, three equal widths (95.33) 8 pt apart across the 302 pt column. THIS STATE: the clip is as it was shot — nothing to bake — so Render Edits is disabled at 45 % (its help tag says so, and the source itself can be approved). See components/README.md.
